title: Global Semiconductor Equipment Sales Hit a Record: How to Read the $40.53 Billion for April–June 2026
excerpt: Global semiconductor equipment sales for April–June, announced by SEMI on September 3, 2026, reached a record $40.53 billion. A beginner-friendly look at the link to AI investment, the difference between sales results and orders or forecasts, what it means for Japan, and the limits of the statistics.
